END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    elementCount : DINT := 0;
    status       : WORD := 16#0000;
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    item   : VARIANT;
    buffer : VARIANT;
END_VAR
VAR
    local_head         : DINT  := 0;
    local_tail         : DINT  := 0;
    local_capacity     : DINT  := 0;
    local_firstCycle   : BOOL  := TRUE;
    local_enqueueTrig  : R_TRIG;
    local_dequeueTrig  : R_TRIG;
END_VAR

// ENGINEERING_CONTRACT
// =============================================================================
// Activation: R_TRIG on enqueue/dequeue detect rising edges only.
// Retention:  local_head, local_tail, elementCount persist across scans.
// Reset:      Any scan where reset=TRUE empties queue regardless of other inputs.
// Same-scan:  Reset > Enqueue > Dequeue priority chain; only one operation per scan.
// Boundaries: Capacity derived from buffer array bounds; elementCount [0..capacity].
// Status:     16#0000 idle/success, 16#8001 empty-dequeue, 16#8002 full-enqueue.
// =============================================================================

local_enqueueTrig(CLK := enqueue);
local_dequeueTrig(CLK := dequeue);

IF local_firstCycle THEN
    local_firstCycle := FALSE;
    local_capacity := TO_DINT(UPPER_BOUND(buffer, 1) - LOWER_BOUND(buffer, 1) + 1);
    local_head := 0;
    local_tail := 0;
    elementCount := 0;
    status := 16#0000;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF reset THEN
    local_head := 0;
    local_tail := 0;
    elementCount := 0;
    status := 16#0000;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF local_enqueueTrig.Q THEN
    IF elementCount < local_capacity THEN
        buffer[local_tail] := item;
        local_tail := (local_tail + 1) MOD local_capacity;
        elementCount := elementCount + 1;
        status := 16#0000;
    ELSE
        status := 16#8002;
    END_IF;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF local_dequeueTrig.Q THEN
    IF elementCount > 0 THEN
        item := buffer[local_head];
        local_head := (local_head + 1) MOD local_capacity;
        elementCount := elementCount - 1;
        status := 16#0000;
    ELSE
        status := 16#8001;
    END_IF;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

status := 16#0000;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```

The rising edge triggers handle enqueue and dequeue requests separately. On reset, all pointers and counters clear. Enqueue adds items at the tail and wraps around using modulo arithmetic, while dequeue removes from the head. The capacity check prevents overflow, and status codes track the operation result.

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_FIFOQueue
VAR_INPUT
    enqueue  : BOOL;
    dequeue  : BOOL;
    reset    : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    elementCount : DINT := 0;
    status       : WORD := 16#0000;
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    item   : VARIANT;
    buffer : VARIANT;
END_VAR
VAR
    local_head         : DINT  := 0;
    local_tail         : DINT  := 0;
    local_capacity     : DINT  := 0;
    local_firstCycle   : BOOL  := TRUE;
    local_enqueueTrig  : R_TRIG;
    local_dequeueTrig  : R_TRIG;
END_VAR

// ENGINEERING_CONTRACT
// =============================================================================
// Activation: R_TRIG on enqueue/dequeue detect rising edges only.
// Retention:  local_head, local_tail, elementCount persist across scans.
// Reset:      Any scan where reset=TRUE empties queue regardless of other inputs.
// Same-scan:  Reset > Enqueue > Dequeue priority chain; only one operation per scan.
// Boundaries: Capacity derived from buffer array bounds; elementCount [0..capacity].
// Status:     16#0000 idle/success, 16#8001 empty-dequeue, 16#8002 full-enqueue.
// =============================================================================

local_enqueueTrig(CLK := enqueue);
local_dequeueTrig(CLK := dequeue);

IF local_firstCycle THEN
    local_firstCycle := FALSE;
    local_capacity := TO_DINT(UPPER_BOUND(buffer, 1) - LOWER_BOUND(buffer, 1) + 1);
    local_head := 0;
    local_tail := 0;
    elementCount := 0;
    status := 16#0000;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF reset THEN
    local_head := 0;
    local_tail := 0;
    elementCount := 0;
    status := 16#0000;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF local_enqueueTrig.Q THEN
    IF elementCount < local_capacity THEN
        buffer[local_tail] := item;
        local_tail := (local_tail + 1) MOD local_capacity;
        elementCount := elementCount + 1;
        status := 16#0000;
    ELSE
        status := 16#8002;
    END_IF;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF local_dequeueTrig.Q THEN
    IF elementCount > 0 THEN
        item := buffer[local_head];
        local_head := (local_head + 1) MOD local_capacity;
        elementCount := elementCount - 1;
        status := 16#0000;
    ELSE
        status := 16#8001;
    END_IF;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

status := 16#0000;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```

The rising edge triggers handle enqueue and dequeue requests separately. On reset, all pointers and counters clear. Enqueue adds items at the tail and wraps around using modulo arithmetic, while dequeue removes from the head. The capacity check prevents overflow, and status codes track the operation result.
